title: FCA scaling cap, DD accumulator hardening, and slop cleanup
description:
Three items from the v1 review:

1. FCA approximate_implications is O(n_attrs^2). Add MAX_ATTRS cap (~100) that drops low-frequency attributes before building formal context. 'in:' path attributes are the main growth vector.

2. DD blast_counts retraction uses fragile exact-match equality. Consider matching the simpler cycle_nodes HashSet pattern or snapshotting the DD collection directly.

3. Slop: partial_cmp().unwrap() on f64 (context.rs:150, review.rs:326), #[allow(dead_code)] on Response::Error (worker.rs:29), unused dd_idle_timeout_sec config, sort_by/dedup_by key mismatch (review.rs:293-297).

acceptance_criteria.text: FCA has MAX_ATTRS cap preventing quadratic blowup
DD blast_counts uses simpler accumulator pattern

decisions: dd_idle_timeout_sec is NOT unused — it's consumed in mcp.rs:178 to configure DdEngine idle timeout. Left as-is.

edges.note: DD accumulator hardening builds on daemon-resident DD
